text:
alex tan: Hey team :wave: I'm Alex (they/them) — starting today as Backend Engineer on Platform. Quick setup question: I can't access the VPN or the internal GitHub org yet. Who do I ping?

devon li: Welcome Alex! :tada: I'll add you to the org in a few minutes. Can you DM me your GitHub handle?

alex tan: @devon it's alextn

maria gonzalez: Hi Alex, welcome! For VPN we use the corp-vpn. @lee can you trigger SSO invite and VPN for Alex?

lee chu: Done — sent SSO invite and VPN instructions. Check email (and spam) and reply to me if the MFA push doesn't show up.

alex tan: Got the SSO invite, thanks. One more thing: SSH key for repo access — does org require a specific format? Here's my public key:
```
ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAIFakeKeyExample alex@laptop
```

samir patel: All good, Alex. I accepted your invite to the repo and added that key. Try cloning:
```
git clone git@github.com:redwood-inference/platform.git
```

hr-bot: Onboarding checklist created for Alex Tan. Next steps: benefits form, profile photo, security training. Link: https://handbook.redwood.example/onboarding

maria gonzalez: Also, fun fact to share — Alex makes sourdough and once shipped a home-baked loaf to the office :bread: Welcome aboard!

alex tan: Love that :bread: excited to be here. I'll ping if anything else breaks in setup. Thanks everyone :heart:
